Service with Pride, since 1980

Vega's Distributors Ltd. began as a sole proprietorship importing products from Mexico and Guatemala. Today it is a three-division group supplying supermarkets, wholesalers and commercial customers across Belize.

Our history

  • 1980

    Eduardo Vega founds the company as a sole proprietorship in the distribution business, introducing products primarily from Mexico and later Guatemala.

  • 1981

    The business moves from San Estevan, Orange Walk to Benque Viejo del Carmen, which has been its home base ever since.

    The published copy says 'a year after' founding. The exact year is inferred and should be confirmed.

  • Today

    Vega's imports dry goods, hotel supplies, construction material, lubricants, fuel, chocolates, wines and spirits from Central America, Asia and Commonwealth regions, and distributes to supermarkets and wholesalers throughout Belize.

Vision

To be a leading distributor in Belize.

Mission

To provide customers with quality products while strengthening customer-service processes and maintaining high standards.

Edited from the published wording for grammar only; meaning preserved. Final wording needs business approval.

Our values

The three values the company publishes.

  • IntegrityDealing straightforwardly with customers, suppliers and colleagues.
  • TeamworkWarehouse, sales and administration working to the same standard.
  • RespectRespect for customers, staff and the communities Vega's serves.
